label: copy-phase echo of digit 3 as the 1st or 2nd original token (early in long sequences)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the fed-back input is the digit 3 and that 3 is original token 0 or 1 (recall_idx 1 or 2, i.e. the step right after <DEL> or the one after that), and at least 3 outputs remain. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on any token other than 3 (one stray c). Magnitude grows with the number of outputs left (to_go): it is weak or silent in short sequences (L 3-5) and strongest in long ones (top examples are all L=8-9 with orig(0)=3). recall_idx 1 (3 as the first original token) carries about 62% of the mass and recall_idx 2 about 38%. When the sequence starts 3 3, both copy steps fire and the second is weaker. Copy-phase 3 inputs at recall_idx >= 3 almost never fire (about 0.1% of mass). The main false positives are short sequences with little left to output.

issues: Minor: the false positives are not scattered. They pile up at the to_go threshold. Precision by to_go is 0.58 at to_go=3, 0.86 at 4, 0.97 at 5, 0.996 at 6 and 1.0 at 7. So the activation is graded in to_go rather than switching on at a sharp cutoff. The explanation already says magnitude grows with to_go, so this is a soft boundary, not a missing class.

I tried other ways of splitting the false positives and none helped. Requiring to_go>=4 for both recall_idx values gives test F1 0.864. Using to_go>=3 for recall_idx 1 and to_go>=4 for recall_idx 2 gives dev F1 0.880. Conditioning on orig(0)==3 or on n_seen(3) does not separate active from inactive steps either: precision stays around 0.81-0.87 in every subset.

Every factual claim checks out on the dev profile. Activation is 100% in the copy phase. in_tok=3 holds all the mass, with one stray 'c'. recall_idx 1 carries 61.8% of the mass, recall_idx 2 carries 38.1% and recall_idx 3 carries 0.1%. Mass by to_go rises to a peak at 6. L=3-5 are weak (0.5-0.7x lift).

Reported test scores reproduce exactly: precision 0.869, recall 0.932, F1 0.899, mass recall 0.978. The missed steps hold 2.2% of the mass. They are mostly weak activations (0.02-0.23 of max) on the same 3-echo in short sequences with to_go of 1-2, plus a few at recall_idx 3, which fits the stated pattern.
